text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold winning positions in small chunks, then later bought stocks again; I should use a consistent portfolio-level plan rather than letting the pleasure of realizing gains drive my timing.","I added to positions at both lower and higher prices, including buying more of Stock B as its price rose. Before adding, I should reassess the stock’s prospects and my portfolio concentration instead of reacting to price moves alone.","My account value rose in some periods and fell in others, so short-term results do not show whether my trading decisions are sound. I should review returns, risk, and diversification over time rather than judging myself by each trade’s gain or loss."]}
